name: Small Dark Room
desc1: This stone chamber is completely bare except for a long, grungy table
desc2: and a wooden chair. It is dimly lit by flickering candles set in
desc3: alcoves in the walls. A dank hole in floor leads down into some sort
desc4: of earthen chamber. Hanging in one corner of the room is a training
desc5: dummy, and it would be possible to practice skills here.
